# Z80 executor against an independent reference at six pair sizes (generated by `emulator_report.py`)

- executor: createZ80TestShader(L, P) from src/lib/gpu/shaders.ts around @neovand/zilion; 128 instructions per program

| 38 | 19 | FFE7 | 100,000 | 9,000 | 101,726 | 7,232 | 42 | 0 | 6,000 (0 / 0) |
| 40 | 20 | FFEF | 100,000 | 9,000 | 101,622 | 7,341 | 37 | 0 | 6,000 (0 / 0) |
| 64 | 32 | FFFF | 100,000 | 9,000 | 100,241 | 8,717 | 42 | 0 | 6,000 (0 / 0) |
| 100 | 50 | FFDB | 100,000 | 9,000 | 98,266 | 10,674 | 60 | 0 | 6,000 (0 / 0) |
| 128 | 64 | FFFF | 100,000 | 9,000 | 97,875 | 11,050 | 75 | 0 | 6,000 (0 / 0) |

Mismatch events by cause, all sizes (each verified at the instruction where it occurs): oracle:unhandled-dd-fd 279,591; zilion:bit-mem-f3f5 1,204; oracle:adc-sbc-hl-z 656; oracle:ld-a-r 492; oracle:in-f-c 181; oracle:ld-r-a 96; zilion:wasted-prefix-r 3
